antispam_setting_monitoring_window_days_: Track new users for this many days after account creation (default: 42 = 6 weeks)
antispam_setting_sliding_window_seconds_: Time window for detecting duplicate/cross-channel messages (default: 300 = 5 min)
antispam_setting_cross_channel_threshold: Number of distinct channels a duplicate must appear in to trigger action (default: 3)
antispam_setting_rate_short_burst_descri: Number of messages allowed per user in a short 30-second burst (default: 5)
antispam_setting_rate_sustained_descript: Number of messages allowed per user over a sustained 2-minute window (default: 12)
